theorem pointwise_53 {α x : ℝ} {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hx : 0 < x) {U V : ℕ} (hU : 1 ≤ U)
    (hV : (2000000 : ℝ) ≤ V) {M r : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hr : 0 ≤ r) {W : ℝ}
    (hW : W ∈ Set.Icc (V : ℝ) (x / U))
    (hS2 : S2 α x (max U (x / (2 * W))) (max V (W / 2)) W ≤
      (2 * M / x + r * x / (2 * W) + W / 2) * logSqSum (max V (W / 2)) W) :
    √(S1 x U W) * (√(S2 α x (max U (x / (2 * W))) (max V (W / 2)) W) +
      √((x / (2 * W) + 1) * (1.4262 ^ 2 * W))) ≤ W * G53 x U V M r W :=

note: Lean keeps κ₁ = 2/π² + κ₀ζ(3/2)³√(x/V)/U as an expression and bounds it numerically only at the chosen parameters (0.23209, 0.24083). κ₂ ≤ 1.93768 and κ₉ ≤ 3.9086 need the unrounded κ₁ = 0.234663, not 0.2347.
